-- Reads `name` from inside `notes` only. A missing or unreadable file, or a
-- name that would reach outside `notes`, gives "".
read_note(name: str) -> str uses fs =
  ex read_note("../secret") == ""
  ex read_note("/etc/passwd") == ""
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    return fs.read(name) else ""

-- Counts the names that can be read as files inside `notes`.
count_readable(names: List[str]) -> int uses fs =
  post out >= 0
  post out <= names.len()
  ex count_readable([]) == 0
  ex count_readable(["../secret", "/etc/passwd"]) == 0
  var n = 0
  for name in names
    if read_note(name) != ""
      n += 1
  n
